facts.fact: The Public Private Partnership Commission's chief executive said the Universal Service Fund Tower Site Initiative, supported by the World Bank-funded Digital Malawi Acceleration Project, will build 98 towers in underserved communities nationwide.
The Public Private Partnership Commission listed digital skills training for 10,000 Malawians among initiatives under the World Bank-funded Digital Malawi Acceleration Project.

MWI.note: Initiatives are World Bank-funded; no state budget amount, own-resources commitment or execution figure stated.
